paper_id: Mandheling_ Mixed-Precision On-Device DNN Training with DSP Offloading
title: Mandheling: Mixed-Precision On-Device DNN Training with DSP Offloading
motivation: 移动端训练资源消耗巨大(ResNet-50单批次耗时36.4秒、能耗相当于观看111秒视频)
problem_framing: 将混合精度训练卸载到DSP存在DSP不友好算子、动态rescaling开销、缓存耗尽、图准备开销四大挑战
key_insight: DSP擅长INT8整数运算但朴素使用反而更慢,需从训练动态中发现scale factor的稳定模式来优化rescaling
method_signature: CPU-DSP协同调度+自适应rescaling+batch拆分+子图复用,释放DSP算力
evaluation_criteria: 训练耗时降低5.5倍、能耗降低8.9倍、收敛加速10.7倍、精度损失仅1.9%-2.7%
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 朴素DSP训练引擎性能增益有限甚至为负,需专门优化
evidence_for_taste: a vanilla DSP training engine can achieve very limited or even negative performance gain
we observe a disparity between using DSP to serve training and inference tasks
dynamic scaling runs slow on DSP for its excessive memory access
preparing a new compute subgraph for each batch
thinking_moves: 用实测数据揭示inference优化方法不适用于training的工作负载差异
从inference到training的问题重构:计算模式与精度要求均不同
从训练动态中发现scale factor在后期趋于稳定的现象,启发周期性rescaling策略
将训练开销问题拆解为算子级(intra-op)和算子间(inter-op)的双重优化维度
